suggestions.topic: Hoodi Glamsterdam fork rescheduling after EIP-8037/8038 audit
suggestions.rationale: Hoodi fork delayed minimum 2 weeks on Oct 26 pending ChainSecurity + Dedaub audit of EIP-8037/8038 blast radius. Audit ETA was ~2 weeks from Oct 26, making Nov 9 the earliest revisit date. Critical path decision needed.

Scope was to be confirmed on the call after ACDT #100 (Oct 12) but was never addressed in #101 or #102. Strong community support for including SETCODEFROM, data repricing (EIP-8279), nonce bump (EIP-8253), and deactivate self-destruct. Blocking devnet-2 launch planning.

suggestions.topic: heze-devnet-2 launch readiness and final scope
suggestions.rationale: heze-devnet-2 target was Oct 28 latest (per ACDT #100). Quick slots (EIP-8198) were excluded in #101; current scope is Beta-4 EIPs only. Confirm final EIP list, client readiness (3+ CL clients required), and new launch date.

suggestions.topic: Hoodi testnet client release status and shadow fork planning
suggestions.rationale: Hoodi shadow fork was planned once all client releases were out (per ACDT #101). Erigon, Geth, and Reth releases were still pending as of Oct 19-26. With Hoodi fork now delayed, confirm release status and whether shadow fork will proceed independent of mainnet fork timing.

suggestions.topic: Shorter slots consensus-specs merge decision (deferred to ACDC)
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #102 deferred shorter slots spec merge to ACDC, requiring majority client agreement. Potuz argued spec changes not needed for devnet testing. Update on whether ACDC reached consensus and implications for heze-devnet-2+.

suggestions.topic: New spec PRs for ePBS: envelope signature clarification and GetPayload gossip check
suggestions.rationale: Two consensus-specs PRs assigned in ACDT #102 (Oct 26): envelope signature backfill clarification (Sam/Nimbus) and GetPayload transaction count gossip check (Nico/Lodestar). Recent actions; confirm if PRs are open and ready for review.
ACDT #101 noted Hegota devnet-1 EL scope to be locked in 'next Monday's call' (Oct 26). That call (#102) focused on Hoodi delay and ePBS; Hegota devnet scope was not discussed. Revisit if ready.
